PVC.Title: Victory Counter
PVC.Type.PositiveHint: Positive track — progress the party wants to make.
PVC.Type.NegativeHint: Negative track — progress that works against the party.
PVC.Overlay.Hide: Hide for me (reopen from the Token controls)
PVC.Overlay.HiddenFromPlayers: Hidden from players — click to reveal
PVC.Overlay.VisibleToPlayers: Visible to players — click to hide
PVC.Overlay.SetHint: Type a number and press Enter to set progress
PVC.Overlay.ResizeHint: Drag to resize the counter; double-click to reset the width
PVC.Panel.Title: Victory Counter Controls
PVC.Panel.NoTracks: No tracks yet. Add one above to display it on every screen.
PVC.Panel.MaxTracksReached: The maximum of {max} tracks is already in use. End a track to add another.
PVC.Panel.TrackNameHint: Shown to everyone, e.g. "Infiltration Points" or "Guard Awareness". Leave blank to use the default name.
PVC.Panel.TargetHint: Progress needed to complete this track (1-100).
PVC.Panel.TypeHint: Positive tracks read as party progress. Negative tracks read as pressure and show their numbers in red.
PVC.Panel.VisibleToPlayersHint: When off, only GMs see this track and its progress chat cards are whispered.
PVC.Panel.PostToChatHint: When off, progress changes to this track post no chat card. The world setting "Post Progress to Chat" must also be on for any card to appear.
PVC.Confirm.ResetContent: Progress will be set back to zero. The track's name, target and type are kept.
PVC.Confirm.EndContent: "{title}" will end and disappear from every player's screen.
PVC.Confirm.EndNote: Nothing else in the world is changed. Use Undo to bring the track back.
PVC.Notify.GMOnly: Only a Gamemaster can change the victory counter.
PVC.Notify.WriteFailed: The victory counter could not be saved. Check the console for details.
PVC.Notify.NoTrack: That track is no longer running.
PVC.Notify.MaxTracksReached: You can only run {max} tracks at once.
PVC.Notify.AlreadyComplete: "{title}" has already reached its target. Raise the target, or enable "Allow Progress Beyond Target" in the module settings.
PVC.Notify.CappedAtTarget: Progress was capped at the target ({target}). Enable "Allow Progress Beyond Target" in the module settings to go higher.
PVC.Notify.OverlayHidden: Victory counter hidden. Reopen it from the Token controls.
PVC.Notify.NowVisible: The track is now visible to players.
PVC.Notify.NowHidden: The track is now hidden from players.
PVC.Notify.FailuresRemoved: Failure tracking was removed in version 3.0. Create a separate Negative track instead.
PVC.Notify.LegacyImported: Imported {count} track(s) from the previous PF2e Victory Counter module. The old data was left untouched.
PVC.Notify.LegacyImportFailed: Tracks from the previous PF2e Victory Counter module could not be imported. The old data was left untouched; check the console.
PVC.Notify.MigrationFailed: Victory counter data could not be migrated. The original data was left untouched; check the console.
PVC.Notify.UILoadFailed: The victory counter interface could not be loaded. Track data is safe and unchanged. This usually means a module file is damaged or was only partially deployed — reinstall the module folder and reload. See the console for details.
PVC.Notify.BootstrapFailed: Victory Counter failed to start and will not appear in the scene controls. Track data is safe and unchanged. Reinstall the module folder and reload; see the console for details.
PVC.Settings.Tracks.Name: Active Track Data
PVC.Settings.Undo.Name: Undo Snapshot
PVC.Settings.Schema.Name: Track Data Schema Version
PVC.Settings.LegacyBackup.Name: Pre-Migration Track Data Backup
PVC.Settings.ImportedLegacyModule.Name: Imported From Previous Module Id
PVC.Settings.OverlayHidden.Name: Overlay Hidden Locally
PVC.Settings.OverlayCollapsed.Name: Overlay Collapsed Locally
PVC.Settings.OverlayOffset.Name: Counter Drag Offset
PVC.Settings.OverlayPosition.Name: Counter Anchor
PVC.Settings.OverlayPosition.Hint: Where the victory counter starts on your screen. You can also drag it by its title bar; double-click the bar to snap back to this anchor. Personal preference — it does not affect other players.
PVC.Settings.OverlayWidth.Name: Counter Width
PVC.Settings.OverlayWidth.Hint: How wide the counter is on your screen, in pixels. Wider means more track cards side by side. You can also drag the grip in the counter's bottom-right corner.
PVC.Settings.OverlayScale.Name: Counter Scale
PVC.Settings.OverlayScale.Hint: Size multiplier for the victory counter on your screen.
PVC.Settings.ShowRings.Name: Show Progress Rings
PVC.Settings.ShowRings.Hint: Draw a circular progress ring on every track, with the current value and target in the centre. When off, tracks use a large figure and a horizontal bar. Affects every player.
PVC.Settings.AllowOvershoot.Name: Allow Progress Beyond Target
PVC.Settings.AllowOvershoot.Hint: When off (the default), a track that has reached its target refuses further increases and says so. When on, progress may exceed the target; the ring still shows at most 100%.
PVC.Settings.PostChat.Name: Post Progress to Chat
PVC.Settings.PostChat.Hint: Post a chat card whenever a track changes. Acts as a master switch: individual tracks can still opt out. Cards are whispered to GMs while that track is hidden from players.
PVC.Settings.Debug.Name: Debug Logging
PVC.Settings.Debug.Hint: Write verbose diagnostics to the browser console, prefixed with [victory-counter]. Also prints the data migration summary.
